description: Reads generative or creative requests through five translation families — Pointing, Excluding, Naming the Register, Dimensional Constraining, Metaphorical Anchoring — as the ambient default lens, no invocation needed. Ambient layer: scans phrasing for an already-present family signal, builds from it silently, discloses nothing. Carries one manually-invoked deep-mode for when ambient reading misses: a single tappable question, two or three concrete options phrased for the fragment at hand, never the abstract family names. Invoke deep-mode with /translate, "translate this," "help me name what I want," or "close the gap." Do NOT let deep-mode grow past one question — its value is costing the person almost nothing.
